items.title: At the Zoo
paragraphs: Last Saturday, my family and I went to the zoo. It was a sunny day, so we took the bus. The zoo was very big and there were many people.
First, we saw the lions sleeping in the sun. Then we watched the monkeys. They were funny and jumped everywhere. My sister took many pictures of them.
After that, we ate lunch near the elephant house. The food was good but expensive. We had a great day at the zoo. I want to go again next month.

items.title: My Weekend
paragraphs: On Friday evening, I stayed at home because it was raining outside. I watched a film on TV with my brother.
On Saturday morning, the sun came out, so we went to the mall with my friends. We bought new clothes and ate ice cream. I found a nice jacket for school.
On Sunday, I helped my mother clean the house. Then I did my homework and read a short story. I love weekends because I can relax and have fun.

items.title: My Holiday in Turkey
paragraphs: Last summer, my family and I went to Turkey for a holiday. We stayed in a small hotel near the sea. The weather was hot and sunny every day.
We visited many old places and beautiful mosques. I liked Istanbul because it was very different from my city. We ate delicious food and took many photos.
The holiday was short but wonderful. We came back home after one week. I want to visit Turkey again next year because I really enjoyed it.

items.title: My New School
paragraphs: I started a new school in September. On the first day, I was a little nervous because I did not know anyone. My new teacher was kind and she helped me.
After a few days, I made new friends in my class. We sit together at lunch and play games after school. My favourite subject is science because it is interesting.
Now I like my new school. Every morning, I wake up early and go there happily. The best thing is that my best friend is in the same class.

items.title: Cooking with My Mother
paragraphs: Yesterday, my mother taught me how to make a cake. First, we bought flour, sugar, eggs and butter from the supermarket. I was very excited because I had never cooked before.
My mother showed me each step carefully. I mixed everything in a big bowl and put it in the oven. After one hour, the cake was ready and it smelled wonderful.
We ate the cake after dinner with my family. They said it was delicious! I felt happy because I made something for my family. I want to cook again next week.

items.title: My Grandfather's Farm
paragraphs: Every summer, I visit my grandfather's farm in the countryside. The farm is far from the city, so we drive for two hours. I love it because it is quiet and green.
On the farm, there are chickens, cows and two horses. I help my grandfather feed the animals every morning. In the afternoon, I ride the small horse and play in the fields.
At night, we sit outside and look at the stars. The air is fresh and clean. I always feel happy there. It is my favourite place in the world.

items.title: Lost in the City
paragraphs: Last month, I went shopping with my cousin. The streets were very crowded, so we walked slowly and held hands. Suddenly, I could not find her!
I was scared because I did not know the area. I looked for her for ten minutes. Then I called my mother and she told me to wait near a big shop.
After fifteen minutes, my cousin found me. She was looking for me too. We were both tired but happy. That day, I learned that I must always tell my mother where I am.

items.title: My First English Lesson
paragraphs: I started learning English two years ago. At first, it was difficult because I did not know any English words. My teacher spoke slowly and she was very patient.
Now, I can read simple stories and write short sentences. I also learned many new words. My favourite part is speaking because I like talking to people from other countries.
Last week, I spoke English with a tourist in my city. He was surprised and happy! I felt proud of myself. I want to learn more English every day.

items.title: A Rainy Day
paragraphs: Last Friday, it rained all day. I could not go outside, so I stayed home and watched the rain from my window. The streets were wet and empty.
In the afternoon, my sister and I made hot chocolate and played board games. We laughed a lot and had a great time together. My father read a book near the fireplace.
In the evening, the rain stopped and we saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky. It was a wonderful day, even though we did not leave the house. Sometimes, rainy days are the best days.

items.title: My Best Friend's Party
paragraphs: Last Saturday, my best friend Nour had a birthday party. She invited ten friends to her house. Her mother made a beautiful cake and we ate pizza and sweets.
We played many games and danced to music. I gave Nour a red notebook because she loves writing. She was very happy and she hugged me.
The party ended at ten o'clock. I was tired but also happy. It was one of the best days of my life. I will never forget it.
